class.name: ScriptExtension
class.brief_description: Virtual interface for implementing a native script resource and its language integration.
class.description: Implement the required virtual methods to provide executable instances, source code, introspection, editor exports, and reload behavior for a custom [ScriptLanguage]. Native pointer hooks require GDExtension and are not supported by generated C# or ordinary GDScript overrides. Instance ownership, placeholder cleanup, and state preservation remain the language implementation's responsibility.

method.name: _can_instantiate
method.description: Overridable implementation of [method Script.can_instantiate].

method.name: _editor_can_reload_from_file
method.description: Returns whether the editor may safely reload this script from its source file. Reject reloads that would discard unsaved source or violate the language implementation's reload requirements.

method.name: _get_base_script
method.description: Overridable implementation of [method Script.get_base_script].

method.name: _get_class_icon_path
method.description: Returns the resource path to the icon used for this script class in the editor, or an empty string to use the default icon.

method.name: _get_constants
method.description: Returns a dictionary mapping script constant names to their values. Used by [method Script.get_script_constant_map].

method.name: _get_doc_class_name
method.description: Returns the class identity used for this script's generated editor documentation.

method.name: _get_documentation
method.description: Returns documentation dictionaries for the script classes defined by this resource. Each dictionary uses the engine's class-documentation schema, including class name, inheritance, descriptions, and member documentation. This is an internal language integration hook.

method.name: _get_global_name
method.description: Overridable implementation of [method Script.get_global_name].

method.name: _get_instance_base_type
method.description: Overridable implementation of [method Script.get_instance_base_type].

method.name: _get_language
method.description: Returns the [ScriptLanguage] implementation that owns this script resource.

method.name: _get_member_line
method.description: Returns the source line for [param member], or [code]-1[/code] when no source location is available. Used by editor navigation.

method.name: _get_members
method.description: Returns the names of the script's members for the engine's script introspection.

method.name: _get_method_info
method.description: Returns a method-info dictionary for [param method], using the schema described by [method Object.get_method_list]. Return an empty dictionary when the method is unknown.

method.name: _get_property_default_value
method.description: Overridable implementation of [method Script.get_property_default_value].

method.name: _get_script_method_argument_count
method.description: Return the expected argument count for the given [param method], or [code]null[/code] if it can't be determined (which will then fall back to the default behavior).

method.name: _get_script_method_list
method.description: Overridable implementation of [method Script.get_script_method_list].

method.name: _get_script_property_list
method.description: Overridable implementation of [method Script.get_script_property_list].

method.name: _get_script_signal_list
method.description: Overridable implementation of [method Script.get_script_signal_list].

method.name: _get_source_code
method.description: Overridable getter for [member Script.source_code].

method.name: _has_method
method.description: Returns whether the script defines [param method], including inherited methods according to the language's lookup rules. Used by [method Script.has_script_method].

method.name: _has_property_default_value
method.description: Returns whether a default value is available for [param property]. Distinguish a missing default from a valid [code]null[/code] default returned by [method _get_property_default_value].

method.name: _has_script_signal
method.description: Overridable implementation of [method Script.has_script_signal].

method.name: _has_source_code
method.description: Overridable implementation of [method Script.has_source_code].

method.name: _has_static_method
method.description: Returns whether [param method] is available as a static method of the script.

method.name: _inherits_script
method.description: Returns whether this script derives from [param script] through its script inheritance chain.

method.name: _instance_create
method.description: Creates a native script instance attached to [param for_object] and returns its opaque native [code]ScriptInstance[/code] pointer. This pointer-based GDExtension hook is for native language implementations; it cannot be implemented through generated C# or ordinary GDScript bindings.

method.name: _instance_has
method.deprecated: This method is not called by the engine.
method.description: Overridable implementation of [method Script.instance_has].

method.name: _is_abstract
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] if the script is an abstract script. Abstract scripts cannot be instantiated directly, instead other scripts should inherit them. Abstract scripts will be either unselectable or hidden in the Create New Node dialog (unselectable if there are non-abstract classes inheriting it, otherwise hidden).

method.name: _is_placeholder_fallback_enabled
method.description: Returns whether placeholder instances should accept fallback property access while the executable script instance is unavailable.

method.name: _is_tool
method.description: Overridable implementation of [method Script.is_tool].

method.name: _is_valid
method.description: Returns whether the script has valid executable code and metadata for its language implementation.

method.name: _placeholder_erased
method.description: Notifies the native language implementation that [param placeholder] has been removed. Release its bookkeeping and retained reload state without dereferencing a destroyed owner. This pointer-based hook is restricted to native GDExtension language implementations.

method.name: _placeholder_instance_create
method.description: Creates the native placeholder instance for [param for_object] used when the script cannot execute, such as during editing or reload failure. Return a compatible native placeholder-instance pointer or a null pointer when unavailable. This pointer-based hook is restricted to native GDExtension language implementations.

method.name: _reload
method.description: Overridable implementation of [method Script.reload].

method.name: _set_source_code
method.description: Overridable setter for [member Script.source_code].

method.name: _update_exports
method.description: Refreshes exported property metadata and editor placeholder properties after source or dependency changes. Preserve compatible existing values when updating placeholders.
